description: This file defines the UnivariateStatistic interface for the Apache Commons Math library. It declares methods for evaluating statistical metrics on data arrays and copying the statistic object.

classes.name: UnivariateStatistic
classes.description: An interface for univariate statistical measures, providing methods to evaluate the statistic on data arrays and to create copies.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the statistic on the entire input array and returns the result.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the statistic on a subarray specified by starting index and length.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of the statistic with the same internal state.
